description: Create Windows To Go and bootable Windows installation/WinPE USB media
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to $cmd"; break }
pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to $cmd"; break }

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw "WinToUSB Inno Setup uninstaller was not found: $uninstaller" }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "WinToUSB uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }

post_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)) { throw "WinToUSB executable was not installed at the expected path: $exe" }
notes: The Free Edition is restricted to personal, non-commercial home use. The installer suppresses its own Start Menu icons so the shortcut is managed by Scoop. Run WinToUSB as administrator when creating or cloning bootable media because these operations modify disk partitions and boot components.
